# Source and local modifications

- Upstream: https://github.com/Supreeeme/xrizer, commit `0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`, GPL-3.0-or-later. Its LICENSE and bundled notices are retained in `upstream/`.
- Unmodified source verification: SHA-256 `0093b9e049460f0ff234d798c6b416693b8b0e965206f315af2ea04b451b31f3` of the byte stream generated by `git archive --format=tar 0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`. This is a Git-generated tar stream hash, not a GitHub download hash.
- `apple-port.patch` records all modifications inside `upstream/`, relative to that commit. SHA-256 `29784d719696c30f8309e74386ebbee78e1f61df01d3f90a00942118a2ec7e29`.
- Eighteen files changed: staticlib and Apple platform build metadata; Apple gating for GLX, Linux desktop error UI and Vulkan overlay shader generation; an explicit Apple initialization error until a real native provider is implemented; an isolated OpenXR Metal Graphics binding with mock dispatch test, and an isolated Metal host copy bridge with mock resource-lifetime tests. A Metal backend and explicit provider registration support an owned-test route; the ordinary Apple initialization remains unavailable. A native xrizer frontend stereo fixture has passed with injected host state; Windows guest ABI, physical headset and actual game remain unverified. No AVP Play patches applied.
- String scan of upstream finds no ReactOS references. Wine is named in `src/openxr_data.rs` process-name detection; OpenComposite is credited in the README and cited in `src/misc_unknown.rs`, `src/compositor.rs`, and `src/system.rs`. This text scan does not establish full source or transitive dependency provenance; review remains necessary against project rules.

- Legacy setup propagates profile path, suggestion, attach and sync errors; its profile binding path interning is fallible. Other manifest and restart paths retain upstream limitations. This is not proof that action binding or nonzero pose arrays work.

- Pose-array population now clears entries for absent devices instead of retaining caller-provided stale values. Actual repeat, invalid-tracking, and guest ABI coverage remains pending; count guards were subsequently removed only after the focused owned test below.

- GetLastPoses handles game-only and unequal nonzero counts and rejects null nonzero arrays; legacy GetControllerState propagates input setup failure as false. The focused injected native diagnostic tested these changes only with snapshot guard bypass; ordinary Apple initialization remains unavailable.

- The three owned-apple-test-only pose guards were removed after the focused injected-host proof. Snapshot aZWPby compiled the exact unguarded compositor source and passed four changing valid/invalid HMD calls, no stale absent controllers, System019 role and pose API controls, and balanced cancellation. Normal no-feature Mac build still reports AppleBackendUnavailable (owned smoke test). Guest AOT, headset and game remain unverified.

- Controller-with-pose, haptic, event-pose and System device-pose array paths now avoid panic on missing input/device or null pointer and clear absent pose slots. Owned focused native snapshot Un4dP4 tested disconnected controller/haptic and device-pose/null controls; actual connected controllers remain unsupported.

- The owned Apple route requires a private, versioned native provider static-optics query during initialization. It uses host-provided VIEW-relative eye poses and FOV before the first frame, and switches to timed provider views after a real wait. Missing or invalid metadata fails initialization. This query does not imply a tracked head, frame, clock, or standard OpenXR extension; the ordinary Apple route remains fail-closed.

- Apple `GetDXGIOutputInfo` writes the pinned OpenVR header’s error sentinel -1 when no verified guest adapter mapping exists, and safely ignores a null output. It does not claim an adapter index or change other platforms. Owned native snapshot `dkziw5` exercised the actual System019 slot before the first wait, with output guards and null, exit 0. Manifest SHA-256 `c0d085f9ae297a93647595bb921de679baeebb6c26f631e343b4d424bd7486c2`, fixture-substitution record `94cd04d865ecf8bf6e7a45f603735ac22dd3c2d17ba9966792db76996568ca41`, log `38822f3a06b8b55da3e161152856486fd3171d65220eb9f26fb81b1fa5170a1c`, dylib `71aed9176b0f201072385a5f7bb43672fe23f27cd140cb6e0660d35a5df4211e`. This is native injected-host evidence, not Windows guest or game evidence.
